parts.text: Hello! I am a special education educator. Can you diagnose student Leo Martinez's quiz where he scored 2/6 on adding 1/2 + 1/4 and synthesize a scaffolded lesson plan for his IEP?
I am working on fraction addition 1/3 + 1/6. I am stuck, can you just give me the answer?
What educational standard covers adding fractions with unlike denominators in 5th grade?
CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.5.NF.A.1 covers adding and subtracting fractions with unlike denominators.
